review_candidates.title: Staff System Admin
review_candidates.description: At Sumerge, Staff IT Engineers own the reliability, security, and performance of our IT infrastructure. They evaluate user needs, design and implement efficient network and system configurations, and ensure seamless operations across endpoints, applications, and cloud environments. Our ideal candidate combines deep technical expertise with a proactive, service-oriented mindset. They take ownership of diagnosing and resolving complex issues, strengthening system security, and continuously enhancing operational efficiency to enable smooth digital experiences across the organization. Requirements · Evaluate user needs and system functionality to deliver reliable, secure, and high-performing IT services that meet business objectives. · Own the diagnosis and resolution of complex IT incidents across infrastructure layers to minimize downtime and service disruption. · Implement, maintain, and optimize network infrastructure components, ensuring scalability, availability, and compliance with IT standards. · Collaborate with the System Administration team to approve and deploy updates, patches, and configuration changes that enhance system performance and security. · Ensure smooth operation of all IT systems — including endpoint protection, print services, and email platforms — through regular monitoring and performance evaluations. · Administer and secure IT systems to maintain optimal reliability, resilience, and alignment with organizational security frameworks. · Deploy and operate security tools to detect, analyze, and remediate vulnerabilities across diverse systems and applications. · Contribute to the continuous development of security policies, procedures, and governance protocols to safeguard Sumerge's IT assets. · Maintain and approve accurate technical documentation and IT asset inventory to ensure traceability, accountability, and compliance readiness. · Supervise and mentor junior IT engineers, fostering technical growth and adherence to best practices. · Collaborate cross-functionally with Infrastructure, Security, and Operations teams to resolve escalations and improve process efficiency. · Report daily progress, incidents, and risk updates to the Senior IT Infrastructure & Security Engineer to ensure operational visibility and alignment Qualifications: · Bachelor's degree in Business Administation, or related field. · 5+ years of experience in IT infrastructure, systems administration, or network management within a technology-driven environment. · Proven ability to diagnose and resolve complex IT and network issues with minimal supervision. · Strong understanding of network architecture, information security principles, and system optimization techniques. · Proficiency in endpoint management, backup and recovery tools, and cloud-based environments. · Excellent analytical, communication, and collaboration skills with a proactive and ownership-driven mindset.

review_candidates.title: IT Operations Supervisor
review_candidates.description: Title : IT Operations Supervisor Location : 6th of October City, Giza Job Type : Onsite | Full Time Please Read the Post Carefully !! Company Overview: RABEA TEA has been ranked among the top 100 local Saudi brands for the year 2013, and became “The House of Quality Tea.” Rabea Tea continued to develop and diversify its products over the years to satisfy all needs and tastes, all supported by the leading packaging techniques that maintain the tea’s freshness Main Purpose: Drive end-to-end IT Operations by managing infrastructure, resolving incidents, and ensuring secure, reliable, business-aligned technology performance. Responsibilities:  -Lead and manage the IT Operations team by assigning tasks, monitoring performance, and providing guidance, to cultivate a high-performing team that ensures the stability and efficiency of the IT environment.  - Oversee the daily activities of the IT support desk by managing ticket queues and prioritizing incidents, to ensure timely resolution of issues and maintain high user satisfaction.  - Manage the IT infrastructure, including servers, networks, and telecommunications, by implementing robust monitoring and regular maintenance, to ensure high availability and reliability for all critical business systems. - Monitor system performance and security by using advanced tools to track KPIs and security alerts, to proactively identify and address potential issues before they impact business operations.  - Manage IT incidents and problems by leading a swift response process to restore service and conducting root cause analysis, to minimize business disruption and prevent future recurrence.  - Collaborate with other departments by acting as an IT business partner to understand their needs, to provide effective solutions, and ensure IT services are aligned with business objectives.  - Manage relationships with IT vendors and service providers by conducting performance reviews against contract terms, to ensure the company receives the expected value and quality of service.  - Stay updated on emerging technologies through continuous learning and research, to recommend and implement improvements that enhance the efficiency, security, and scalability of the IT infrastructure. Job Requirements: - Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field is required. - Minimum of 7 years of experience in IT, with at least 3 years in a leadership or supervisory role. - Proficient in English - Excellent use of Microsoft Office Productivity Suite (Word, Excel, and PowerPoint). Relevant certifications such as ITIL, Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA), or Microsoft Certified Solutions Associate (MCSA) are preferred

review_candidates.title: English Chat Account B1+|Grads|13k
review_candidates.description: Company Description TP Group, formerly known as Teleperformance, is a global leader in digital business services with nearly 47 years of experience. In response to the AI era, the company has evolved to become sharper, more modern, and highly customer-focused while maintaining its strong industry presence. TP combines human empathy with intelligent, technology-driven solutions to support clients worldwide. The organization is committed to innovation, continuous improvement, and building future-proof service experiences. Candidates can expect to join a dynamic company that values adaptability, professionalism, and growth. Role Description This is a full-time, on-site English Chat Account role based in New Cairo. In this position, team members handle customer inquiries through written English chat, provide accurate information, and resolve issues efficiently while maintaining a professional tone. Daily tasks include responding to customer messages, clarifying questions, documenting interactions, and following established procedures and quality standards. The role also involves collaborating with supervisors and colleagues, attending training sessions, and applying feedback to improve performance. Team members are expected to meet productivity and quality targets while delivering a respectful, inclusive customer experience. Qualifications Strong communication skills, particularly in written English, with the ability to interact clearly and professionally. Customer service abilities, including problem-solving, patience, and a customer-focused approach. English teaching or training experience that supports language clarity and effective guidance is an advantage. Translation skills or experience working with multilingual environments are beneficial. Minimum B1+ English level, with graduates preferred for this role. Ability to work on-site in New Cairo and maintain consistent attendance for full-time shifts. Comfort with using computers, chat platforms, and basic office software. Strong attention to detail, reliability, and willingness to learn and adapt to new processes.

review_candidates.title: Customer Service Representative
review_candidates.description: Company Description Raya CX is a next-generation BPO and customer experience management provider serving clients across diverse industries. Since 2001, the company has been a trusted partner for customer service, technical support, and global services for Fortune 1000 organizations in North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Africa. Raya CX operates from competitive and highly skilled labor markets, offering integrated outsourcing solutions powered by advanced technology. The company focuses on robust strategies, continuous improvement, and innovation to deliver high-quality customer experiences and long-term client partnerships. Role Description The Customer Service Representative role at Raya CX is a full-time, on-site position based in Qesm El Maadi. In this role, the representative will handle inbound and outbound customer interactions via phone, email, chat, or other channels, providing accurate information and timely resolutions. Daily tasks include responding to inquiries, troubleshooting issues, documenting interactions, and escalating complex cases when necessary. The representative will work to maintain high levels of customer satisfaction, adhere to service standards, follow established procedures, and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives. Collaboration with team members and supervisors to share feedback, support operational goals, and uphold Raya CX’s customer experience values is an essential part of the role. Qualifications Strong customer-facing skills, including experience in Customer Service and Customer Support. Ability to enhance Customer Experience and maintain high Customer Satisfaction levels. Prior experience as Customer Service Representatives or in similar contact center roles is preferred. Clear and professional verbal and written communication skills in English; additional languages are a plus. Comfort working in fast-paced environments, with strong problem-solving and active listening abilities. Proficiency in using computer systems, CRM tools, and contact center platforms. Availability to work full-time on-site in Qesm El Maadi, including flexible shifts if required. High school diploma or equivalent; post-secondary education in business, communications, or related fields is an advantage.
